en_title: Nvidia Brings DLSS 5 to Hogwarts Legacy, But Some Fans Can't Tell The Difference
cn_title: 《霍格沃茨之遗》新技术差异难辨
subtitle: 细微变化值不值得
opus_summary: 英伟达将于11月为《霍格沃茨之遗》加入新版DLSS 5，称模型速度提升至9月版的两倍。展示画面变化细微，有人质疑性能代价，也有人赞赏其保留原有美术风格。

paragraphs.en: About a month after it debuted in NBA 2K27, DLSS 5 is now being added to Hogwarts Legacy , with a newer, faster model.
paragraphs.cn: DLSS 5在《NBA 2K27》中首次亮相约一个月后，如今也将加入《霍格沃茨之遗》，采用更新、运行速度更快的模型。

paragraphs.en: In a blog post, Nvidia announced that it is launching a new model for DLSS 5 that's — according to Team Green — twice as fast as the model that debuted in NBA 2K27 last month . While the Basketball game will be getting an update that adds this new model, and thus improves performance, Nvidia is also bringing the neural rendering tech to Hogwarts Legacy and Where Winds Meet in November.
paragraphs.cn: 英伟达在一篇博客文章中宣布将推出DLSS 5的新模型。据该公司称，新模型的运行速度是上个月在《NBA 2K27》中首次亮相的模型的两倍。这款篮球游戏将通过更新加入新模型，从而提升性能。英伟达还将在11月把这项神经渲染技术带到《霍格沃茨之遗》和《燕云十六声》中。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia has been hard at work getting DLSS 5 to run well enough that people will actually turn it on when they're playing games. It's not hard to see why that's a major focus; when I first tested the tech back in September , I found that it could absolutely cripple my frame rate at 4K on the RTX 5090. It wasn't long ago, either, that Nvidia debuted the technology at GTC 2026 in March , where it needed to run on two RTX 5090s to deliver a playable experience, and even then it was super limited.
paragraphs.cn: 英伟达一直在努力优化DLSS 5的运行表现，好让玩家真正愿意在玩游戏时开启它。不难理解为什么这是英伟达的重点：我在9月首次测试这项技术时发现，即使用RTX 5090以4K分辨率运行，它也可能让帧率大幅下降。英伟达在3月的GTC 2026上首次展示这项技术，距今也没多久。当时需要两张RTX 5090才能达到可玩的水平，即便如此，限制仍然很大。

paragraphs.en: Now, though, Nvidia claims the new model is twice as fast as September's model, and ten times faster than it was when DLSS 5 was first revealed. If that's true — and I won't know that until I actually test it — it makes sense that developers are now willing to add the feature to their games.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，英伟达如今声称，新模型的运行速度是9月模型的两倍，更是DLSS 5首次公布时的十倍。如果确实如此，开发者现在愿意把这项功能加入游戏也就不难理解了——但我得亲自测试后，才能知道这一说法是否属实。

paragraphs.en: But unlike some of the deep-fried examples I've seen of DLSS getting modded into games, the Hogwarts Legacy examples Nvidia shared in its blog are a lot more subtle. Rather than completely changing the way characters look, like it did when DLSS 5 was first revealed, it mostly just looks like it balances lighting and subsurface scattering.
paragraphs.cn: 但我看过一些通过MOD把DLSS加入游戏的例子，画面处理得十分失真。相比之下，英伟达在博客中分享的《霍格沃茨之遗》示例，变化要细微得多。它没有像DLSS 5首次公布时那样，彻底改变角色的外观，看起来主要只是平衡了光照与次表面散射效果。

paragraphs.en: And I'm not alone there. Over on Twitter, NikTek posted a GIF of him scrubbing through an image comparison with DLSS 5 turned on and off, and noted how small of a difference it makes. He then wonders who would actually use it with such a minor visual change and a big performance hit. However, there were some folks who applauded the subtle changes, with jayv7s replying, "This is the correct way to use it, no exaggerated AI slop filters on top, just normal pure improvement."
paragraphs.cn: 不止我一个人有这种感觉。NikTek在X上发布了一张GIF，展示他来回拖动滑块，对比开启与关闭DLSS 5的画面，并指出两者差别很小。他随后提出疑问：画面变化这么小，性能损失却很大，到底谁会用它？不过，也有人赞赏这些细微的变化。jayv7s回复道：「这才是正确的用法，不要往画面上叠加夸张的AI垃圾滤镜，只做正常、纯粹的改善。」

paragraphs.en: However, the subtlety of DLSS 5 will ultimately depend on the developer. There are plenty of dials that devs can adjust to make the game look as natural as possible, or leaning in the opposite direction to make games look like some kind of nightmare ripped straight from Midjourney. However, it is at least a little bit reassuring that in NBA 2K27 and now in Hogwarts Legacy, the developers are at least trying to maintain the same aesthetic.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，DLSS 5带来的变化有多细微，最终还是取决于开发者。开发者可以调整许多参数，让游戏画面尽可能自然；也可以反其道而行，让游戏看起来像是直接从Midjourney里搬出来的某种噩梦。不过，《NBA 2K27》和如今的《霍格沃茨之遗》的开发者至少都在尝试保留原有的美术风格，这多少让人安心了一点。

paragraphs.en: No matter how subtle it is, though, DLSS 5 does work by using AI to re-draw games , even though it is anchored by the geometry and color data provided by the game. That's definitely enough to turn some people off of this tech, but if the changes are subtle enough and the performance continues to improve at this pace, I can see it eventually getting added to more than one or two games.
paragraphs.cn: 但无论变化多么细微，DLSS 5的工作方式确实是用AI重新绘制游戏画面，尽管它以游戏提供的几何与颜色数据为依据。仅凭这一点，就足以让一些人不愿使用这项技术。不过，如果画面变化足够细微，性能也能继续以这样的速度改善，我认为它最终有望加入更多游戏，而不只是一两款。
